It reads: 'the timeline replays from its session seed, clock and presses with the climate row, year position, sites, `light` mode and view hour in force at each moment (§6.1 *The weather stream*) — a year-position change from a week with no live kind into a live one and back, a press at a moment with no live kind and a view hour crossing a kind's `hours` among its fixtures (… `weather.replay` 0)'. Volume 12 takes T124-9 (T-V12-57; the take-over row l. 18680) and measures it with `weather.replay`. It still states the old bar. §3.15.14's bullet (V12 l. 2787–2788): 'two runs from one session seed, clock and set of presses give the same spells'. The registry row (l. 1212): 'two timelines from one session seed, clock and set of presses, spells differing in kind, start or length (0)'. Its weather fixtures (l. 2766–2768) step only the week and the clock. So V12's run names neither the replay's other inputs nor the three fixtures the bar names. The five-engine half is determinism §6.5 (9)'s run (l. 10185–10191), which stages all three, so nothing built changes.
required_change: V12 §3.15.14's T124-9 bullet: '— `weather.replay`: two runs from one session seed, clock and set of presses give the same spells; across the five engines it is determinism §6.5 (9)'s run.' → '— `weather.replay`: two runs from one session seed, clock and set of presses, with the climate row, year position, sites, `light` mode and view hour in force at each moment (§6.1 *The weather stream*), give the same spells, on the weather fixtures and on T124-9's three: a year-position change from a week with no live kind into a live one and back, a press at a moment with no live kind (starting none) and a view hour crossing a kind's `hours` under `light: 'time'`; across the five engines it is determinism §6.5 (9)'s run.' The registry row's last clause: 'two timelines from one session seed, clock and set of presses, spells differing in kind, start or length (0)' → 'two timelines from one session seed, clock and set of presses, with the climate row, year position, sites, `light` mode and view hour in force at each moment and T124-9's three fixtures among the runs, spells differing in kind, start or length (0)'. T-V12-57: '`weather.replay` fails a planted spell drawn from the host's clock' → '`weather.replay` fails a planted spell drawn from the host's clock and one carried into a week with no live kind across a year-position change'.

As `hood.constants` columns, both cells took V12 §3.11's default line: `corpus` at M-CAL (J-V1.97; V12 l. 2042: "volume 1's `hood.*` default rows").
